title: local-engineer configuration
description: /data/config/le.yaml. Per-hardware tuning belongs in the active profile, not here (design v3 §9.2).

addr.description: Bind address. §4.1 publishes 127.0.0.1:7777; the container image sets 0.0.0.0 because Docker cannot reach a loopback bind inside a container, and publishes as -p 127.0.0.1:7777:7777 instead.

acp_addr.description: Binds the ACP-over-TCP bridge (§4.3). Empty leaves it off.

acp_command.description: The ACP agent to run per connection, argv style. Required when acp_addr is set: a bridge with no agent accepts connections it cannot serve.

mode.description: embedded starts llama-server as a supervised child; external talks to one the operator runs; none disables inference for indexing-only use.

args.description: Appended after the arguments derived from the active profile, so an operator can override any of them — llama-server takes the last occurrence of a repeated flag. Everything the profile expresses belongs there: §9.3 puts thread counts and offload layers in the profile on purpose.

model.description: The GGUF to serve: an absolute path, or a filename under /data/models. Configuration rather than part of the profile, because a profile describes the machine and the same machine runs different models.

then.$comment: External inference with nowhere to send it is a misconfiguration the loader already rejects; the schema has to agree or a user is told a file is fine and then has it refused.

watch_enabled.description: The §3.4 file watcher. Marks index scopes dirty as files change; le doctor reports the count as index drift.

egress.description: The allowlisting egress proxy of design v3 §6.1. Off by default: a machine whose premise is that it has no egress should not acquire some from a shipped config file. Contradicts `offline`.

enabled.description: Start the proxy with `le api`. Forced off in offline mode.

deps_port.description: Loopback port for the deps lane.

docs_port.description: Loopback port for the docs lane. Must differ from deps_port.

host.description: An exact host, or one leading wildcard label as in *.example.com. Never `*`.

lanes.description: Lanes this rule covers. Absent means every lane.

why.description: Required. A rule that cannot say why it exists is one nobody can judge later.

offline.description: Refuses to route any role to a non-local provider, at startup rather than at call time.
